title: When Large Language Models Meet Law: Dual-Lens Taxonomy, Technical Advances, and Ethical Governance
findings: A study cited in the paper found that when Large Language Models were applied to Indian Supreme Court cases, they exhibited religious biases in their outputs, despite having superior statutory prediction accuracy compared to baseline models.
references: Andrew Abbott. 1981. Status and status strain in the professions. American journal of sociology 86, 4 (1981), 819-835.
